title: 天外魔境II 卍MARU

versions.note: the CRC-32 of the data track's boot block (docs/format.md)

sources: The harness alone, from the game's file (docs/first-script.md): no reader's snapshots, no memory written

Kanji and signs are Shift-JIS; the one-byte codes are turned into Shift-JIS by the game's own table, which the script reads from memory as the game has it: no table in the catalog. The codes that aren't characters were read off pages beside the screen
The route was found by running the same core outside the harness, then replayed in the harness from power-on in one run with the script loaded
What it said agreed with the rows read off 31 of 31 pictures, over 4 scenes (the house, the shrine's gate, the shrine's hall, the village); it said nothing on the 4 screens without text
Of the 31, 10 are the same search's answer at different places and 6 repeat a talk (the same person spoken to again)
The build check was added after that run; outside the harness the script so checked, loaded as a host would (it held from the title on), said the same 44 pages on the same frames over the route
notes: Read by the script games/pce-cd/PCECD-92261ECE.lua: a message window's pages, each once it has typed out and waits. Not read: who speaks (the game shows no name), menus, fights, choices.
